statement.title: Assessing project feasibility, economic and environmental viability.
paragraphs: We develop and assess the integrated feasibility of project concepts, combining economic, financial and environmental assessment. With expertise in economic modeling, financial analysis and environmental impact evaluation, we give clients the insight to make data-driven decisions on investment, project design and implementation.
Our record in large-scale infrastructure and policy projects is about one thing: making sure initiatives are economically viable, environmentally sustainable and socially impactful.

scene.title: From the factory floor to the port to the policy table — one chain, five stations.
scene.lead: Each station names the kind of question IP3 has answered there, with the assignments on the record.

steps.label: Firms
steps.title: Productivity and technology in firms
steps.text: A firm-level technology adoption survey for the World Bank, covering eight manufacturing sectors, to identify productivity barriers and inform policy reform: questionnaire, programming guidance, fieldwork training, data quality control and analysis.
points: Survey design, implementation and data quality control

steps.label: Value chains
steps.title: Value chains and market structure
steps.text: Value-chain mapping for ten selected industries with a firm survey and competitiveness analysis; market demand and supply-chain mapping for steel; and case studies of base-of-pyramid business, analysed for economic profit and social value.

steps.label: Trade
steps.title: Ports, logistics and trade
steps.text: Technical advice on economic and financial analysis for Payra Seaport, Bangladesh’s third seaport, including a 15-year financial model; a regional study of cargo loss and damage across Bangladesh, India and Nepal; and analysis for LDC graduation and the services-trade rules that shape it.

steps.label: Investment
steps.title: Investment appraisal and special economic zones
steps.text: Economic and financial modeling to evaluate project viability and potential returns, with cost-benefit analysis and financial forecasting for public and private investment.
points: Strategic financial planning, including long-term investment roadmaps and funding strategies
Equity investment policy, special-purpose company formulation and shareholder agreements for special economic zone financing
Market, financial and economic feasibility for large urban and industrial investments

steps.label: Policy
steps.title: Economic analysis for growth that creates jobs
steps.text: Economic uncertainty demands rigorous analysis. We apply tailored economic methods to evaluate policies, investments and programs, giving leaders the evidence to move forward with confidence.
points: Cost-benefit analysis and outcome quantification to allocate resources efficiently
Economic modeling, predictive analytics and scenario planning to simulate policy outcomes
Data-driven recommendations for inclusive economic growth, sustainability and resilience

rows.title: Economic and financial feasibility
points: Advanced economic and financial modeling for evaluating project viability and potential returns
Cost-benefit analysis and financial forecasting for public and private sector investments
Strategic financial planning, including long-term investment roadmaps and funding strategies

rows.title: Environmental and social impact
points: In-depth analysis of environmental and social impacts for compliance with sustainability and regulatory standards
Climate resilience and green-finance principles integrated into project planning

rows.title: Integrated feasibility frameworks
points: Holistic frameworks that combine institutional, economic and environmental dimensions for large-scale projects
Transformative solutions that balance economic growth with environmental stewardship

rows.title: Regulation that lets business grow
rows.text: Evidence-based regulatory frameworks that enhance compliance, streamline processes and promote economic competitiveness, while safeguarding environmental sustainability, social equity and consumer protection.
